segments.he: כַּוָּנַת ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁצּוֹעֵק אֵלֵינוּ "שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי" וְכוּ' הוּא
segments.en: For through this is the essential acceptance of the faith of the Unity of G-d that we accept upon ourselves each day — through which we merit to draw close to Him and to unite and to be included in Him constantly, from all places in the world — until we merit the complete redemption through Moshiach, our righteous one, who will merit to attain and reveal the Fiftieth Gate — through which all will walk in this path of engaging in the saying of Tehillim and hisbodidus greatly, greatly — until we merit to rectify everything through His great kindness.

segments.he: וְזֶה עִקַּר הַתְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה אֲנַחְנוּ לָשׁוּב אֵלָיו יִתְבָּרַךְ עַל יְדֵי הַהִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁלָּנוּ. כִּי זֶה הַוִּכּוּחַ בֵּין ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ וּבֵין יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁה' יִתְבָּרַךְ צוֹעֵק אֵלֵינוּ (מַלְאָכִי ג') שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וְאָשׁוּבָה אֲלֵיכֶם שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ נָשׁוּב תְּחִלָּה. וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אוֹמְרִים (אֵיכָה ה') הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ ה' אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה וְכוּ' שֶׁהוּא יְשִׁיבֵנוּ אֵלָיו וְכַמּוּבָא בַּסְּפָרִים.
segments.en: "Whoever says Tehillah LeDovid [Psalm 145] three times every day is assured that he is a son of the World to Come" [Berachos 4b] — since through this one will certainly merit teshuvah. For the essential teshuvah is through speech, as it is written: "Take with you words and return to Hashem" [Hoshea 14:3]. As our Sages, of blessed memory, taught [Yoma 86]: "I ask of you nothing but words." And this is the above-mentioned aspect — that one merits to teshuvah through the saying of Tehillim, which is entirely holy speech — cries and supplications and requests and songs and praises to Him. And this is the quality of the aleph-beis [alphabetic] arrangement in which Tehillah LeDovid is written. For the aleph-beis contains all the twenty-two letters, in which all the words in the world are encompassed — for they are all combinations of the aleph-beis. And the essential flaws of all the sins in the world are in the aspect of the twenty-two letters — that a sin draws the letters that are in that matter to a place that draws them, Heaven forfend, to the sitra achra [the other side] — Heaven forfend, G-d spare us. For the essential life-force of all things is the letters that exist within that thing, through which it was created — as it is written: "By the word of Hashem the heavens were made" [Tehillim 33:6]. And through a transgression one draws those letters to a wrong place. Therefore the essential rectification is through speech — for through speech one returns and combines the letters of speech to the good, and through this the flaw of the sin is rectified, since the essential flaw was in speech. As is understood from the words of our Master, Teacher, and Rebbe, of blessed memory, in many places. Therefore through Tehillah LeDovid — which contains the aleph-beis that is the totality of all speech in the world — through this one can rectify everything. For one will draw upon oneself holiness to sanctify the speech greatly — to say always songs and praises greatly with the speech that contains the aleph-beis — and one will draw upon oneself His compassion and goodness, as mentioned in this holy Psalm: the greatness of the Creator without limit, His compassion over all His works and His abundant goodness and great kindness, and that He is close to all who call Him. And it concludes: "My mouth shall speak the praise of Hashem, and all flesh shall bless His holy Name forever and ever" [Tehillim 145:21] — through which everything will certainly be rectified, for all combinations — which are the totality of speech in the world — will be transformed and included in the holy aleph-beis of words of hisbodidus, songs and praises to G-d.

segments.he: וְעַל יְדֵי תְּהִלִּים שֶׁכּוֹלֵל כָּל מ"ט שַׁעֲרֵי תְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת מ"ט אוֹתִיּוֹת הַשְּׁבָטִים מ"ט יְמֵי הַסְּפִירָה. מ"ט אוֹתִיּוֹת שֶׁבִּשְׁמַע וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְתַּקֵּן הַכּל. כִּי תְּהִלִּים נֶאֱמַר עַל יְדֵי דָּוִד מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת מָשִׁיחַ שֶׁיִּזְכֶּה לְהַשִּׂיג שַׁעַר הַחֲמִשִּׁים שֶׁכּוֹלֵל הַכּל, שֶׁהוּא שֵׂכֶל נִפְלָא שֶׁזּוֹכִין עַל יְדֵי זֶה לְהַכְנִיס בְּלֵב יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁיִּצְעֲקוּ תָּמִיד לַה' יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁיְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אֵלָיו. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה בְּעַצְמוֹ יִהְיֶה נֶחְשָׁב לְהִתְעוֹרְרוּת שֶׁלָּנוּ כְּאִלּוּ אָנוּ שָׁבִים אֵלָיו מֵעַצְמֵנוּ. כִּי בֶּאֱמֶת כָּל צַעֲקָתוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ שֶׁצּוֹעֵק אֵלֵינוּ שׁוּבוּ אֵלַי וְכוּ'. כַּוָּנָתוֹ זֶה בְּעַצְמוֹ שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ נִצְעק אֵלָיו תָּמִיד הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ ה' אֵלֶיךָ וְכוּ'. נִמְצָא שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ אֵין מַחֲלקֶת וְחִלּוּק כְּלָל בֵּין כְּנֶסֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵין ה' יִתְבָּרַךְ רַק שֶׁאֵין כָּל אֶחָד מֵבִין כַּוָּנָתוֹ הַקְּדוֹשָׁה. וְכָל זֶה מֵחֲמַת שֶׁלּא נִתְגַּלָּה עֲדַיִן שַׁעַר הַנ'. אֲבָל עַל יְדֵי תְּהִלִּים נִמְשָׁךְ הֶאָרַת שַׁעַר הַנ' שֶׁכּוֹלֵל הַכּל מִתַּתָּא לְעֵלָּא וּמֵעֵלָּא לְתַתָּא עַד שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לִצְעק אֵלָיו תָּמִיד אֵיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִתְתַּקֵּן הַכּל וְכַנַּ"ל. (הִלְכוֹת קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע הֲלָכָה ה אוֹת י):
segments.en: And certainly this is a great and easy counsel that all can fulfill. For one can merit to teshuvah and the life of the World to Come through speech alone.
